mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REPORT ( REPORT_ID, TARGET_ID, TARGET_TYPE, REASON, MEMBER_ID ) VALUES ( SEQ_REPORT.NEXTVAL, #{targetId}, #{targetType}, #{reason}, #{memberId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.TARGET_ID, R.TARGET_TYPE, R.REPORT_DATE, R.REASON, R.STATUS, R.REPORT_RESULT, R.MEMBER_ID, M.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, D.PROFILE_IMG FROM REPORT R JOIN MEMBER M ON (R.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID) LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL D ON (M.MEMBER_ID = D.MEMBER_ID)
ORDER BY R.REPORT_ID DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE REPORT SET STATUS = #{status}, REPORT_RESULT = #{reportResult} WHERE TARGET_ID = (SELECT TARGET_ID FROM REPORT WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId}) AND TARGET_TYPE = (SELECT TARGET_TYPE FROM REPORT WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId}) AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.TARGET_ID, R.TARGET_TYPE, R.REPORT_DATE, R.REASON, R.STATUS, R.REPORT_RESULT, R.MEMBER_ID, M.NICKNAME AS writerNickname, D.PROFILE_IMG FROM REPORT R JOIN MEMBER M ON (R.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID) LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL D ON (M.MEMBER_ID = D.MEMBER_ID) WHERE R.REPORT_ID = #{reportId}

SELECT R.REPLY_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.REPLY_CONTENT, R.CREATE_DATE, R.REPLY_STATUS, R.REF_ID, R.CODE, M.NICKNAME AS replyWriterNickname, D.PROFILE_IMG AS replyWriterProfileImg FROM REPLY R JOIN MEMBER M ON (R.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID) LEFT JOIN MEMBER_DETAIL D ON (M.MEMBER_ID = D.MEMBER_ID) WHERE R.REPLY_ID = #{targetId}

select: SELECT MEMBER_ID FROM REPORT WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
